high_level_description: stc brand style, a split night desert scene showing an offshore oil rig transitioning into an SUV driving through rocky desert terrain, with a satellite overhead.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Two panels side by side: a lit offshore oil platform over dark water under a starry sky on the left, and a rocky desert canyon at dusk on the right.

elements.desc: A satellite with solar panels positioned in the starry sky above the rig.
A white SUV with a roof-mounted device driving across the desert terrain, kicking up dust.
